name: eifgb-web
description: EIFGB on the web: play, load and (later) edit games in the browser

scripts.prepare-site: node scripts/build-words.mjs && node scripts/bundle-games.mjs && node scripts/bundle-gallery.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs --strict
scripts.build: npm run prepare-site && tsc --noEmit && vite build
